paragraphs: If you make cannabis products, you must tell the Office of Cannabis how you will run your business.
We will ask you for the following information on the manufacturing operations form of the cannabis business application.

sections.heading: Manufacturing process
paragraphs: We will ask what you plan on doing at your business, including:

sections.heading: Extraction solvents
paragraphs: If you will do extraction, we will ask about that process. We will also ask if you will use:
If you will use nonvolatile solvents, you must specify which ones you will use:

sections.heading: Packaging
paragraphs: If you package cannabis products, we will ask you to upload a diagram of your packaging.

sections.heading: Infusion processes
paragraphs: If you will infuse cannabis products, we will ask you to describe how you do infusion.

sections.heading: List your products
paragraphs: We will ask what kinds of products you will manufacture. They include:
Extracts, such as tinctures, oils, shatter, or wax
Concentrates without solvents, such as kief, hash, rosin
Cannabis manufacturers are not allowed to manufacture noncannabis products.

sections.heading: Reducing odors outside
paragraphs: You must have ventilation so the public cannot smell cannabis from outside.
We will ask if you will use charcoal filters to vent air to the outside. We will also ask about other methods you will use to reduce odors.
